items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: That was a wonderful recording, Dave.

ctx.x: I've heard engineers tell the musicians that there wasn't enough separation. So they really isolated them like you're talking about. Did you ever have any problems with that on the audience? Where you couldn't hear the other members of the band?

I did an album in Philadelphia with the band I was with up there. And it was a rock and roll studio primarily. They did rock and roll dates. Knew nothing about setting up for a Dixieland band. So what he did was put the trombone player and myself in a booth and closed the door on us. We had no earphones. What we did is count it off and then we had to watch the drummer watch his stick to keep time. Because we couldn't hear what was going on. We could, when we weren't playing, we could hear what was going on. But…
